title: Relay-aware reads
spec: Add src/venue/relay.ts: relayTransport({ venue: Transport, relayBase, relayToken, rooms, clock }): Transport. Read urls for a relayed room are rewritten to the relay (same path and query, header x-relay-token) and served from there. If the relay answers non-2xx or throws, the venue is used and the relay is skipped for 30 s. If the relay's last_seq for a room does not advance for 120 s, the venue is used for 5 min (a frozen relay is worse than none). Writes and non-relayed rooms always go to the venue. Pure state in the closure; clock injectable.
done: Recorded relay and venue fixtures show reads go to the relay, fall back on failure, and return after the cool-down.
